contract: Item/file downloads enforce library/download permissions and source-defined lookup order, provide usable media or ZIP content/filename/MIME, and return required missing/denied statuses. Encoding, compression and error text are free unless a real client consumes them.

invariants.contract: A directory download is a readable zip with the item folder's relative filenames and unchanged contents, built from the folder at request time, repeatable, and a single-file root item is sent as the plain file.
exceptions: Inherited evidence reference was not confirmed as a current assertion for this invariant; map exact Go assertions before claiming coverage.

Historical pre-rewrite observation (not a fixed representation requirement): Directory download produces a zip whose entries (name/size/CRC32) match upstream exactly; both zippers use STORE mode so CRC equality proves byte-equal content; response streams chunked without Content-Length.

invariants.contract: Item and file downloads need the download permission of the resolved user (API keys resolve to their user), a revoked permission applies to the next request, and a refused request changes nothing.
exceptions: Inherited evidence reference was not confirmed as a current assertion for this invariant; map exact Go assertions before claiming coverage.

Historical pre-rewrite observation (not a fixed representation requirement): canDownload=false → sendStatus(403) with the express 'Forbidden' text body; api keys resolve to their user (TokenManager.js:277-305) and do NOT merge key permissions into the runtime user.

invariants.contract: For the file download the library file is resolved before the download permission is checked: missing file id 404, real file without permission 403, every time.

invariants.contract: A recorded library file whose disk file is gone answers 404 on the stream and download routes without path details, and stored rows stay unchanged.

Historical pre-rewrite observation (not a fixed representation requirement): If the requested library-file record exists but its disk path is missing with ENOENT, upstream returns 404 'File not found'; a previously selected audio MIME type is preserved with Express string charset, Content-Length, and weak ETag headers.
